Vehicles: Kenney Car Kit (sedan-sports.glb, hatchback-sports.glb, sedan.glb, suv-luxury.glb, truck.glb), CC0 1.0.
https://github.com/shorepine/kenney/tree/main/3d/car
Adaptation: node transforms, game-scale conversion, circular 1:1 wheel geometry, material slot classification.

Head: Kenney Mini Characters (character-male-a.glb head-mesh), CC0 1.0.
https://github.com/shorepine/kenney/blob/main/3d/mini-characters/character-male-a.glb
Adaptation: head-mesh extraction, normalized game proportions.

https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

NPCs: Meshy-generated driver, passenger, and road worker, with Meshy humanoid rigs and Walk/Run clips.
The three assets/meshy-npc-*-animated.glb files in dist contain one skinned model and both clips per character.

Coastal scenery and sky: Meshy-generated coconut palm and passenger jet.
Runtime files: assets/models-optimized/meshy-coastal-palm.glb, assets/models-optimized/meshy-passenger-jet.glb.
Clouds are rendered as volumes by the game shader.

City architecture: Meshy-generated townhouse, apartment building, and office tower.
Runtime files: assets/meshy-city-townhouse.glb, assets/meshy-city-apartment.glb, assets/meshy-city-office.glb.

Scenery: Meshy-generated streetlight, wind turbine, coastal boat, and Cham tower.
Runtime files: assets/models-optimized/meshy-streetlight.glb, assets/models-optimized/meshy-wind-turbine.glb, assets/models-optimized/meshy-coastal-boat.glb, assets/models-optimized/meshy-cham-tower.glb.
Coastal dog: Original GLB generated by tools/create-coastal-dog.mjs. Game loads assets/models-optimized/coastal-dog.glb.
